roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/run-detail/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: One agent run as a page: AppHeader, a PageHeader with a Runs breadcrumb, the run's meta line and Ask, then the kit RunDetail block with calls="all" and the run trace. The monitor is a one-row bar (status, agent, headline, elapsed, cost; Pause and Stop run while running), the step trail and compact trace sit beside every started step's ToolCallCard, the failed one open with its error, attempt and Retry. Below 640 a back bar (Runs, Ask) replaces AppHeader and the page is one column.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (monitors, step lists, call cards, traces, dialogs)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view; a failed or running run has none
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Render the page content inside a main landmark; the top bar is AppHeader (a header landmark) when wide and a nav named Back when narrow
The run is one kit RunDetail with calls="all": every started step's ToolCallCard, the failed one open; Retry only on that ToolCallCard
Stop run asks once in the kit AlertDialog before it ends the run; Pause keeps it resumable
Status is always an icon and a word (monitor Badge, trail, calls), never colour alone
defaults: Demo is Northwind's Invoice reconciler on INV-1842 (Halvorsen Freight): failed at Match payments, step 2 of 4; Running and Done states
One agent, so no agents prop and no AgentTree; trace passes TraceWaterfall spans and shows compact under the trail
Ask is a neutral sm outline Button with MessageCircle, in the PageHeader actions (wide) or the back bar (narrow)
Below 640 the headline shortens to the step count, the meta line drops "today", and the trace hides; time and cost stay in the monitor bar
